what: A stage pinned at the screen center (island illustration) and its actors change state each time a marker between the flowing text passes the bottom edge of the screen — on (from 20px below · .8 scale into place), dim (.2), center (flies in from 1000px at the side), left · right (exits toward that side and disappears). Each change takes .2s ease-out. Scrolling back up steps over the same markers in reverse

options.[data-fx-part=actor][data-key]: Actor — the position (position: fixed, where it turns on) is set by the consumer. data-enter="right|left" When on, it first waits outside the --fx-travel distance
options.[data-fx-part=cue][data-cue]: Marker — 1px line in flowing text (parent needs position). data-cue="Name=State …" States are on·off·center·left·right, if left empty (name=) back to the initial state. Reapplies past markers in document order
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Duration and curve for state changes (via style), default .2s ease-out
options.--fx-from-x · --fx-from-y · --fx-from-sc: Position and size before turning on (set per actor via style) — original character 20px lower (half of top 130→90), rock .8x
options.--fx-travel: Fly-in distance, default 1000px (half of the original right: -2000px + margin auto — 500px on phones)

use: …
note: Actors are position: fixed, so they are not placed inside an ancestor that has a transform. At the marker where the stage section ends, clear all actors (name=) so it does not remain over the next section

from.where: index.html .lb-stage (Discovery 1 — the center island lights up and two characters and a rock rise, then between the three riddles a travel image flies in from the right or left and out, and the island fades to .2 above the text)
